checkpoint_epoch: decision.v2/features.v2 plus SHA256 of THIS immutable ABI file. Keep sealed decision.v1/features.v1/0b3aadfe... constant pair distinct. Loader requires one matching tuple across selected records; mixed/new-vs-old contracts reject. No old weight admission by relabeling.
construction: Register stable opaque bindings first; freeze base_index mapping; encode all base records with base_index only. Append context records with base_index only. Construct separate root_index mapping replacing card/stack gathers by their appended context records. Never reuse root_index while building any bank record.

card_context.attached_to: base public card/reference ref or null, exactly from existing actor observation
card_context.incoming_attachments: commutative multiset of base source-card refs from known public attached_to edges
card_context.incoming_stack_targets: ordered list in public stack order; each entry has base stack ref and commutative multiset of incidence slots. Slot={path:ordered semantic field/mode/index list,quantity:strict distribution amount or null}. Never opaque IDs as path text or numeric features.

stack_context.announced_targets: finite public projection encoded with BASE refs and actor-relative players; ordered lists/mode text retained
stack_context.legacy_targets: existing actor observation targets, unchanged, independently retained as already-public data

coverage_ceiling: ONE-HOP public incidence only. Context dependencies never recurse into other context records. Not an injective graph encoder, full mechanics/choice coverage, current-target legality proof, temporal-history model, learned strength result, or privacy/kernel certificate.

dataset_api.DatasetRun: existing dataset_version keyword retained; source engine epoch changes naturally; never rewrite old manifest/source hashes
dataset_api.episode_records: existing args + public_context=False explicit bool; True requires decision_frame=True; capture observe/prompts/decision_context BEFORE teacher chooser. False retains existing v1/default and sealed decision_frame=True path.
dataset_api.validate_episode: existing dataset_version keyword retained; dataset.v2 input validation dispatches exact decision.v1/v2 schema

entities: Two-phase Node[]: ALL base records first (cards, stacks, authorized options/costs/permissions and explicit unknown public references), then card_context/stack_context records. Every bank-record ref uses BASE indices and points strictly earlier. Only root/action refs select CONTEXT indices for cards/stacks; all other refs retain base gathers. No raw/alias identifiers in semantic nodes.

functions.TrainingEnvironment.decision_context: (seat)->public_context; current nonterminal actor only, over ACTOR _view, no mutation
functions.encode_state: (frame)->EncodedTree; exact dispatch by frame version, no silent relabeling

labels: outside features; accepted-action labels and actual actor-seat terminal returns only

limits.validation: Before copying/model allocation; ALL base+context records count together within max_entities 4096 and other unchanged limits; reject without truncation or cap increase

number.value: finite number; scalar model input x/(1+abs(x))

ref.index: zero-based entity gather ONLY; never scalar/token embedding

text.value: semantic UTF8 string; position-aware byte pool; full text retained

announced_target_fields.mode_targets: commutative semantic mode-text -> exact nested fields target_player/target_card_id/target_stack_id (actual api_contracts.ModeTarget)
announced_target_fields.target_card_id: typed card opaque reference; no printed lookup outside authorized observations/prompts
announced_target_fields.target_card_ids: ordered list of typed card opaque references, multiplicity retained
announced_target_fields.target_distribution: commutative reference/player -> strict nonnegative int quantity; dynamic keys are gathers, not text features
announced_target_fields.target_player: strict int 1 or 2, encoded actor-relative self/opponent

public_context.current_serializer_limit: serialize_match does not expose these player announcements; no UI/API/engine/serializer change. New opt-in projection is confined to training actor _view.
public_context.excluded: all other payload keys, effect parameters, private continuations, captured incarnation references, logs, knowledge snapshots and hidden-zone/card lookup
public_context.seat: strict int current actor 1 or 2; exactly equals observation.seat and acting_seat
public_context.stack: same IDs and order, exactly once each, as observation.stack

stack_entry.announced_targets: exact finite projection below; absent announcement uses empty object, not inferred targets
stack_entry.announcement_available: strict bool: genuine __announced_targets dict is present; absent is false, present malformed is reject
stack_entry.reference_lifecycle: literal unknown; announcement is not proof of current target legality/incarnation/source continuity
stack_entry.stack_id: gather-only opaque reference to the matching public observation stack entry

public_context.unknown_reference: when an actually announced typed reference has no actor-authorized descriptor, register only a bounded public_reference base record with role card/stack and visibility unknown; never query hidden/current engine facts or infer controller/type/name

text_encoder.claim: order-sensitive signal, not injective or reversible
text_encoder.empty: three zero pools and length zero

versions.context_optin: mtg.dataset.v2 with decision_frame=True/public_context=True: decision.v2/features.v2/new ABI hash
